blocks.markdown: These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our [Commits Page](https://github.com/fmhy/FMHYedit/commits/main) on GitHub or [Updates Channel](https://redd.it/17f8msf) in Discord.

items.markdown: Added a new backup site **[FMHY X](https://fmhy.net/other/backups)** that has a bunch of new and experimental [features](https://i.ibb.co/HL1cq43H/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/3kPD77T.png) like live link statuses, a private mode, one-click proxy mode, and more, ty to both @WilkinsCoffeeArchives + @Zenith for making this.
Added a **[Recently Removed](https://fmhy.net/recently-removed)** page to our site, this will track the last 30 days of removals + links to the GitHub changes themselves, ty to @bread for doing this.

Updated search engine to show more relevant results, give suggestions if nothing is found, save last 20 searches, and added a "show more results" option, ty to @bread for doing this. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/FkZfdmDP/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/PV8HGwv.png)

Added [Search Scroll to Match](https://i.imgur.com/prj36Pm.mp4), search results will now take you directly to selected result, rather than just the section head, ty to both @bread + @none of your business for doing this.
Added [Active TOC Highlighting](https://i.imgur.com/Ms1B7zI.mp4) support for smaller screens, ty to @bread for doing this.
Added section for [Pokémon Games](https://fmhy.net/gaming#pokemon) under Browser Games.

Added section for [Go / Baduk / Weiqi](https://fmhy.net/educational#go-baduk-weiqi) under Hobbies, ty to @Dan for [doing this](https://i.ibb.co/99TPQZMn/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/APqaeez.png).
Added sections for [Fashion / Clothing](https://fmhy.net/misc#fashion-clothing) + [Sports](https://fmhy.net/misc#sports) under Misc.
Added section for [Economics](https://fmhy.net/educational#economics) under Edu > Humanities.

Merged all [Password Managers](https://fmhy.net/internet-tools#password-managers) into one section, and added platform icons for each, ty to @nug for doing this. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/qYLDsNjb/Before-After-Video-Editors.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/wZnPpCk.png)

Added Platform Icons + cleaned up [Video Editors](https://fmhy.net/video-tools#video-editors) section, ty to @wispy for doing this. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/wZ3q52Pz/Before-After-Video-Editors.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/0Rt6W8Z.png)
Added platform icons to both [Minecraft Launcher](https://fmhy.net/gaming-tools#launchers) sections. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/JRWxjLtk/123123123.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/Ejm9AHr.png)

Added Platform Icons to the [Text Editors](https://fmhy.net/text-tools#text-editors) section, ty to @litekin for doing this. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/vCRP3yww/34253453.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/O7meW3S.png)

Disabled the transparency effect on sites drop down menu to make them easier to read, ty to @Zenith for doing this. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/dwJnyw1V/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/EDoUOD6.png)
Made single page markdown accessible on [site itself](https://fmhy.net/single-page.md) rather than just API page, should be faster now, ty to @bread for doing this.
Starred [r/CrackWatch](https://fmhy.net/gaming-tools#gaming-tools) in Gaming Tools, popular and useful piracy game release tracking group.
Starred [HizSearch](https://fmhy.net/gaming#download-games) in Game Download, multi-site game download search engine, uses trusted sources, has a nice UI, and active development.
Starred [NASA2Explore](https://fmhy.net/educational#astronomy) in Astronomy section, the official source of all NASA images, including full metadata.

Starred [LocalTube Manager](https://fmhy.net/social-media-tools#youtube-tools) in YouTube Tools, extension that allows you to use YouTubes features without an account, including subscribing, playlists, and notifications, also allows you to export data to sync across devices.
Starred [OpenCode](https://fmhy.net/developer-tools#coding-agents-extensions) in AI Coding Agents, has good free models + seems to work well for people.
Starred [DOS Zone](https://fmhy.net/gaming#browser-emulators) in Browser Emulators, retro PC browser emulator that works well + has a big library.
Starred [Shizuku Fork](https://fmhy.net/mobile#android-device) in Android Device, fixes multiple features, adds QoL updates, and is maintained well.
Starred [SteaMidra](https://fmhy.net/gaming-tools#steam-epic) in Steam Tools, multi-tool that includes DLC unlockers, multiplayer fixes, and a manifest tool.
Starred [ReadYou](https://fmhy.net/mobile#android-rss-readers) in Android RSS Readers, clean design, offline support, Google Reader + Fever API sync
Starred [Gadgetbridge](https://fmhy.net/mobile#android-utilities) in Android Utilities, open-source gadget manager w/ support for 300+ devices and no account required.
Starred [SmartTube](https://fmhy.net/video#android-tv-firestick) in Android TV, works on lots of TVs, has improved navigation, and is preferred over TizenTube by some.
Starred [Lucas Chess + Chess Tempo](https://fmhy.net/educational#chess) in Educational Chess section. Feature-rich chess learning platforms both of which seem to be well liked and good for beginners.
Starred [nakarte](https://fmhy.net/misc#maps) in Maps section, world map with multiple layers and street views all combined into one.
Starred [OpenFront](https://fmhy.net/gaming#strategy) in Browser Strategy Games, open-source Conquest / War style game with active multiplayer community.
Starred [setlist.fm](https://fmhy.net/audio#concerts-live-shows) in Concerts / Live section, in-depth database of setlists for almost every concert and tour in history.
Starred [GiveWell](https://fmhy.net/misc#assistance-charity) in Charity / Donations section, charity research group, publishes their research process online, and charges no fees.
Added [Spicy Lyrics](https://fmhy.net/audio#spotify-tools) next to Spicetify. Improved lyrics with very nice UI, not technically a star, but people seem to really like it so it felt worth mentioning.
Removed AnimeKai (and yflix) as their [datacenter caught fire](https://i.ibb.co/PG1hTsLr/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/IbmnBHC.png) and they're no longer able to continue the projects.
Removed Fluxy Repacks as they're [shutting down](https://i.ibb.co/s8YxT58/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/qNrK4g8.png).
Removed AnimeTosho as they're shutting down.
